scope: Proposition 5.1 (Projective lifting) of the manuscript “Reconstruction from Milnor K-theory modulo the characteristic” (preprints/Reconstruction-from-Milnor-K-theory-modulo-the-characteristic-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df8a6b4a54b121c6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 8-9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E and E′ be finite-dimensional vector spaces over fields H and C, respectively, with dimensions at least three. Every bijection ψ : PH(E) → PC(E′) that maps lines onto lines is induced by an additive bijection S : E → E′ satisfying S(av) = σ(a)S(v) (a ∈ H, v ∈ E) 8 for a field isomorphism σ : H → C. The map σ is unique, and S is unique up to multiplication by an element of C×.
